headline: Police block protesting students outside Shikkha Bhaban
summary: HSC examinees marched to the Secretariat in Dhaka, demanding the resignation of Education Minister ANM Ehsanul Hoque Milon.
details: Police stopped a group of protesting students outside Shikkha Bhaban in Dhaka today as they marched towards the education ministry.
The students, primarily HSC examinees, were demanding the resignation of Education Minister ANM Ehsanul Hoque Milon.
The protesters reached the area around 4:00 PM after marching through the Dhaka University campus, but were blocked by police barricades.
Earlier in the afternoon, between 50 to 100 students assembled at the Science Lab intersection at 2:35 PM and blocked traffic for 15 to 20 minutes.
After leaving the intersection, the students marched towards the Secretariat before being halted by police at Shikkha Bhaban.
Similar protests and road blockades by HSC examinees were also reported in Uttara and Chattogram.
caption:

Earlier in the afternoon, between 50 to 100 students assembled at the Science Lab intersection at 2:35 PM and blocked traffic for 15 to 20 minutes.

After leaving the intersection, the students marched towards the Secretariat before being halted by police at Shikkha Bhaban.

Similar protests and road blockades by HSC examinees were also reported in Uttara and Chattogram.

headline: 771 deaths total as 5 more children die from measles symptoms
summary: Over 1,000 children were infected in the last 24 hours, according to the latest report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
details: According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), five more children died from measles symptoms within a 24-hour window from Tuesday to Wednesday morning.
The DGHS report released on Wednesday, July 15, reveals that since March 15, a total of 676 people have died from measles symptoms and 95 from confirmed measles cases.
This brings the total death toll to 771 people across the country.
In the last 24 hours alone, 1,007 children were infected with either confirmed measles or measles-like symptoms.
The health authorities continue to monitor the situation as the number of infections rises rapidly.
caption:
771 deaths and over 1,000 new infections in a single day. The measles crisis is worsening.

The health authorities continue to monitor the situation as the number of infections rises rapidly.
